title: D-0
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: During the hunt for the Sith Wayfinder, Rey and her friends encountered a deactivated Droid named D-0. The Droid had belonged to Ochi, the Sith assassin. Poe Dameron later realized that D-0 had information that could help lead the Resistance to Exegol. After their victory, D-0 celebrated with BB-8 and their friends.
